description: Open Maps for Europe is EuroGeographics' service for discovering, viewing, licensing and downloading pan-European open data built from the official map, geospatial and land information of its member national mapping and cadastral agencies, harmonised to common specifications. The first project, co-financed by the Connecting Europe Facility with NGI Belgium, ran to 31 December 2022 and recorded over 4,000 registered users and about 4,700 dataset downloads; the current service is co-funded through DIGITAL Europe by a consortium of EuroGeographics and the mapping and cadastral agencies of Belgium, France, Greece, Spain and the Netherlands. Coverage: Europe; EuroGlobalMap (multi-themed topographic data at 1:1 million), EuroRegionalMap (1:250,000), EuroDEM (elevation at 1:100,000), the multilingual Open Gazetteer, an Open Cadastral Map, a high-value large-scale pan-European prototype and pan-European imagery, with country-by-country attribution statements. Format and access: web application with dataset pages, downloads and a WMS map service; free, with user registration for downloads. Licence: the EuroGeographics Open licence, a worldwide royalty-free licence to reproduce, adapt and redistribute with attribution, which the site compares to CC BY; some national cadastral layers follow national open licences. Caveats: the site renders by script, so dataset versions, file formats and release dates were not read; the layer themes inside each product were not read. Simulation uses: consistent cross-border topographic base layers and terrain for continental network and hazard exposure models. Related records: GISCO's harmonised healthcare services layer (data-gisco-healthcare-services-europe) is another pan-European reference dataset.
